symptoms: Small water-soaked lesions that turn brown to purple with concentric rings on leaves
prevention: Ensure good field drainage, avoid overhead irrigation, practice crop rotation

symptoms: Yellowish oily spots on upper leaf surface with white downy cottony growth beneath
prevention: Canopy thinning for sunlight penetration, prophylactic copper sprays

symptoms: White ash-like powdery growth on leaves, shoots, and young berries leading to berry cracking
causes: Warm dry weather with high morning humidity (20-30°C)
organic_treatment: Wettable sulfur 80% WDG @ 2g/L or Ampelomyces quisqualis @ 5g/L
prevention: Pruning excess vegetative growth, timely prophylactic sulfur dusting

symptoms: Third or fourth leaf from top shows yellowing, cane split longitudinally reveals reddish pith with white cross bands and alcoholic odor
causes: Infected seed setts, waterlogged poorly drained soils
organic_treatment: Sett dipping in Trichoderma viride culture (10g/L) for 30 mins
chemical_treatment: Sett dipping in Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1g/L before planting
prevention: Use certified disease-free setts, practice 3-year crop rotation, burn infected crop residue

symptoms: Yellow to orange uredinial pustules arranged in linear stripes along leaf veins
causes: Cool humid weather (10-15°C with dew or intermittent rain)
prevention: Cultivate rust-resistant varieties, avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization
